title: Three people found dead on small boat in Channel crossing attempt
summary_full: Group of migrants found unresponsive off coast of Dunkirk after attempting to reach UKThree people have died while trying to reach the UK on a small boat after one of the busiest days for Channel crossings this year.The group of migrants were found dead on a boat off the coast of Dunkirk on Thursday morning, the French coastguard said.
